data.description: A nightmare constructor and his horror share a mental link that allows for communication across any distance (as long as they are on the same plane). This communication is a free action, allowing the nightmare constructor to give orders to his horror at any time. In addition, magic items interfere with the nightmare constructor's connection to his horror. As a result, the nightmare constructor and his horror share magic item slots. For example, if the nightmare constructor is wearing a ring, his horror can wear no more than one ring. In case of a conflict, the items worn by the nightmare constructor remain active, and those used by the horror become dormant.
data.name: Link
